title: fix(service-automation): converge a connector definition change on every replica

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D2HoQfwCF75b2EvnX1Ze8Uc)_

Fixes #28002

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none in skills (`git grep -n -i -E "replica|cluster|metadata\.mutated|peer" -- skills/ | grep -i connector` finds 0 lines); docs follow-up owed and outside this card's file surface: `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx` §6.2 (the lane 2 row's "Converges" column and the "Lane 2" subsection name only ObjectQL's object registry, while the automation service's flows and, after this PR, its materialized connectors converge on lane 2 as well) and `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` (the fault table's "runtime reload (Studio publish / dev reload)" row now also covers a direct active save and a change made on another replica)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在一个副本上保存、发布或删除连接器定义后，其它副本现在也会重新物化该连接器；直接 `PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/:name`（不走发布门）也会让写入的那个副本自己生效。
- 为什么改：之前只有发布的那台副本通过本机的 `metadata:reloaded` 重建实例，其它副本虽然经 lane 2 收到了变更，但自动化插件的监听器只处理 `flow`，于是一直用旧定义直到重载或重启。
- 风险与回滚：只是让已有监听器对 `connector` 变更多排一次「软」对账（与 reload 同一路径），不新增集群通道；发布方会对账两次，第二次签名不变、不重建（已测）。回滚即还原本 PR 的 `plugin.ts`。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`（`subscribeFlowMutations` 里新加的 `connector` 分支与新方法 `queueConnectorMutationReconcile`）；`connector-definition-cluster.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/connector-definition-cluster.test.ts`，预期 7/7 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`AutomationServicePlugin` subscribes to the metadata protocol's post-persistence signal (`onMetadataMutation`, #21725), and its listener returned for every type but `flow`. A connector definition change therefore re-materialized only where `metadata:reloaded` fired: on the replica that published it (`ObjectQLPlugin.announcePerItemPublish`). That hook is kernel-local. Lane 2 (`metadata.mutated`) did deliver `connector/NAME` into a peer's mutation listeners, as #27977 measured, and nothing there acted on it.

Now the listener also handles a `connector` mutation whose state is not `draft` (`active` or `deleted`) by queuing `queueConnectorMutationReconcile`: the soft reconcile `metadata:reloaded` runs (`reconcileDeclaredConnectors(ctx, { fatal: false })`), on the existing reconcile queue, so it never interleaves with a credential write or another reconcile. The reconcile re-reads the declaration from this replica's own protocol view, the same read the reload path makes. No new lane, channel or payload: a peer converges on the lane 2 replay it already receives (triage 6517791280, §6.2's single-signal rule).

- Coalesced: while one mutation-queued reconcile is waiting to start, further connector mutations add nothing. The flag clears when the run starts, so a mutation reported during a run queues one more.
- A failure is logged (`warn`, cause in `meta` per #5575) and leaves the next reload or restart to reconcile, as lane 4's receipt does.
- Flow mutations take the same path as before. Every other type is still ignored.

## Tests

`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-definition-cluster.test.ts` (the #27977 two-kernel harness: real `ObjectKernel`, `ObjectQLPlugin`, driver-sql on one shared better-sqlite3 file, lanes 2 and 4 attached as the cluster bridge attaches them):

- The #27977 `it.fails` pin is now a plain `it`: the peer follows a published definition with no reload on the peer.
- New: the publishing replica reconciles from both of its signals. For two publishes it runs 4 reconciles (its own `metadata:reloaded` plus its own mutation listener; lane 2's loopback guard drops the bus echo), and the provider is called exactly `[V1, V2]`, so the second run is a no-op.
- New, the card's side finding: a direct active save (`saveMetaItem` with no mode, the call behind `PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/:name`) re-materializes the writing replica and converges the peer. The same listener covers it, so it is pinned here and not widened elsewhere.
- New: a deleted connector is torn down on both replicas.
- New control: a draft connector save and a flow save run no connector reconcile on either replica (counted through a spy on `reconcileDeclaredConnectors`, attributed per plugin instance), the provider is not called again, and the flow save still arms the flow on both replicas.
- The existing reload control now runs the peer with lane 2 off, so a `metadata:reloaded` is again its only trigger: the peer holds nothing before the reload and converges from its own read after it.

## Acceptance notes

- The reconcile reads the protocol's execution view with no organization, as the reload reconcile does, so an org-scoped connector mutation converges exactly as far as a reload would.
- A held instance (a refused credential, or since #28014 a configuration fault met on a retry) is skipped by an unchanged-signature reconcile, as on a reload. An edit of its declaration re-attempts it, now on every replica.
- The descriptor audit (`auditDeclaredConnectors`, the inert-descriptor warning) still runs at `kernel:ready` and on `metadata:reloaded` only. This PR adds convergence, not another warning per save.
